text:
alex_sales: Heads up — POC signed with FinCo. They want to purchase the POC thru AWS Marketplace but procurement mandates a single consolidated invoice to match their PO. Also asking for a 20% discount for a 6-month commit. Can we support billing alignment or a special flow? Need answer by EOD.

maria_ps: cc @devon_pricing @sam_ops — quick sanity check: marketplace generally invoices the buyer directly, right? If so, we might not be able to provide their single invoice unless we do a direct contract.

devon_pricing: Correct — AWS Marketplace charges the buyer and remits to us. We can't change buyer invoice contents. Marketplace can do SKU-level discounts but special terms (20% off for 6mo) require deal desk + partner manager + listing update.

sam_ops: Two practical paths: 1) Move them to Dedicated/reserved capacity (we invoice them monthly and can accept PO). 2) Use a reseller partner or private contract outside marketplace. Both need legal and finance signoff.

procurement_josh: From procurement side: they will not accept separate marketplace invoices per transaction. They need a single vendor invoice referencing their PO. Marketplace purchases usually create multiple invoices, so that's a blocker unless buyer uses a consolidation service.

devon_pricing: Short-term workaround: offer a marketplace promo SKU for the POC (smaller discount, can be live in days) + convert to Dedicated commit for the paid phase where we can invoice them and apply the 20% commit discount.

sam_ops: Example invoice mapping we can provide for Dedicated:
```
PO: <PO#>
Company: FinCo Inc
SKU: REDW-DED-1
Term: 12m (or 6m with special approval)
Billing cadence: monthly
```

alex_sales: Customer insists the POC must happen via marketplace due to cloud procurement rules. Any way to mimic marketplace purchase but still generate our monthly invoice? @licensing-bot any constraints?

licensing-bot: Automated note: AWS Marketplace does not permit sellers to issue consolidated buyer invoices. Reseller or private contract required for consolidated invoicing.

maria_ps: Deal Desk action: I'll open a request — include customer PO, desired SKU, discount %, and whether they require consolidated invoice. @devon_pricing please prepare price comps vs list and a recommended path (market promo vs dedicated commit).

devon_pricing: Will do. I'll prepare two options: (A) Marketplace promo — 10% off for the POC (fast, low friction); (B) Dedicated commitment — 20% for 6mo but needs contract & legal (slower). Numbers by noon.

procurement_josh: Note — if we go the Dedicated contract route, procurement can sign a vendor addendum to accept our monthly invoices. Legal turnaround ~10 business days.

alex_sales: Thanks all — I'll echo to FinCo: we can offer a marketplace promo immediately or a committed Dedicated deal that satisfies their single-invoice requirement but takes longer. Will push for decision and update here by tomorrow.

maria_ps: Add to the deal desk ticket: expected ARR, billing cadence preference, and whether data residency/audit logs are required. Also loop in our marketplace PM contact if we choose SKU changes. :thumbsup:
